[PATH:theoretical] Theoretical model of export earnings volatility under free trade with imperfect competition and sticky prices in manufacturing vs. perfectly competitive commodity markets (e.g., extending Newbery & Stiglitz, 1984, or Broda & Tille, 2003) — Provides a formal framework to predict how asymmetric price transmission interacts with export structure to amplify volatility, and identifies conditions under which diversification into manufacturing stabilizes earnings. This can be calibrated to post-1980 trade liberalization parameters for Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America.
